📖 How to use

  1. Choose your fasting plan (16:8 is the classic start).
  2. Press Start fasting — the timer keeps running even if you close the tab.
  3. Watch your progress toward the eating window; press End to finish early.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does the timer keep running if I close the page?

Yes. Your start time is saved in this browser, so reopening the page shows the correct elapsed time.

What can I drink while fasting?

Water, black coffee and plain tea are generally considered fine. Anything with calories breaks the fast.

Is intermittent fasting safe for everyone?

No. It is not advised for pregnant or breastfeeding women, people with a history of eating disorders, or some diabetics. Check with a doctor first.
